answers.sql: SELECT (curr.amount * 100.0 / prev.amount) - 100.0 FROM revenues curr JOIN revenues prev ON curr.category = prev.category AND curr.months = prev.months WHERE curr.category = 'Service revenue' AND curr.period_end = '2024-09-30' AND prev.period_end = '2023-09-30'

SELECT (curr.amount * 100.0 / prev.amount) - 100.0 FROM activity_metrics curr JOIN activity_metrics prev ON curr.metric = prev.metric AND curr.months = prev.months WHERE curr.metric = 'Nominal payments volume' AND curr.period_end = '2024-06-30' AND prev.period_end = '2023-06-30'

SELECT ((r_curr.amount * 100.0 / r_prev.amount) - 100.0) - ((v_curr.amount * 100.0 / v_prev.amount) - 100.0) FROM revenues r_curr JOIN revenues r_prev ON r_curr.category = r_prev.category AND r_curr.months = r_prev.months CROSS JOIN activity_metrics v_curr JOIN activity_metrics v_prev ON v_curr.metric = v_prev.metric AND v_curr.months = v_prev.months WHERE r_curr.category = 'Service revenue' AND r_curr.period_end = '2024-09-30' AND r_prev.period_end = '2023-09-30' AND v_curr.metric = 'Nominal payments volume' AND v_curr.period_end = '2024-06-30' AND v_prev.period_end = '2023-06-30'

SELECT (r_curr.amount / 10.0) / v_curr.amount FROM revenues r_curr CROSS JOIN activity_metrics v_curr WHERE r_curr.category = 'Service revenue' AND r_curr.period_end = '2024-09-30' AND v_curr.metric = 'Nominal payments volume' AND v_curr.period_end = '2024-06-30'
